gaps.evidence: RMA currently reports a descriptive fit only; this application declines those inferential claims.
gaps.boundary: Comparing measurement methods on the same specimens is paired. Independent-group inference would not solve this application's method comparison.
gaps.priority: Strongest scientific development candidate; requires a methods contract and review before implementation.
